verdict.rationale: CT Corporation offers entity-management and compliance software, so in-product AI insights are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack only records that the host serving CT Corporation's pages blocked access with a Cloudflare challenge, and no product content was retrieved. With no evidence of AI-generated insights or suggestions, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
